## Summary

Provide a short, clear description of the feature you are requesting.

## Problem or Motivation

What problem does this feature solve, or what need does it address? Why is it valuable?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision the feature working. Be as specific as possible.

## Affected Area

- [ ] Crowd simulation / MASS framework
- [ ] Heatmap visualization
- [ ] UI or widgets
- [ ] IPC or tooling
- [ ] Import or export pipeline
- [ ] Build, packaging, or automation
- [ ] Plugin or third-party integration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternative approaches or workarounds you have considered and why they fall short.

## Acceptance Criteria

What conditions must be met for this feature to be considered complete?
